text.tspan: osa-dryer: common power module, ladder diagram (draft 1, 2026-11-05)
Read each rung left to right. A box is a part; the label is the part's name in the wire list. Dashed lines are outside the common power module.
MAINS SIDE (inside the common power module, behind the barrier)
supplementary breaker, protects the 120 V side only (motor and supply)
unswitched: the heat module has its own contactor
barrier: no mains below this line
24 V SIDE (SELV: everything the control module and the heat module's coil circuit touch)
RLY_HEAT_LO is one changeover contact: common 11 at the node, n.c. 12 feeds the HI branch,
n.o. 14 feeds the LO branch, so LOW wins if both requests are asserted
24 V only while air is proven
request lines: 24 V through the coil; the control module sinks 8 to 40 mA to 0V to assert
J1.1, J1.2 +24V to the control module
Not drawn: J2 (passive sensors, no connection to the power module), wire colors, terminal torque. See common-power-module.md for the wire list.
